purpose: Same immutable candidate-axis observation can serve multiple independently versioned q models

tables.candidate_registry: one immutable record per registered candidate; aliases explicit
tables.direct_observation: append-only per actual axis; integer gate counts, all basis ops, depths, circuit/preparation identities, control receipts, native exit/reap, build/compile/control wall and peak RSS semantics; unknown fields remain null
tables.model_registry: model_id/version/formula/code SOURCE/coefficients artifact/training IDs/holdout IDs/domain/profile/compiler; retain earlier models
tables.prediction: prediction_id/model_id/candidate-axis full key/predicted_gate_count_literal/status/role; never put predictions in measured column
tables.model_comparison: observation_id/prediction_id/evaluation protocol; error metrics and aggregate comparisons require separate future analysis approval
tables.applicability: explicit EXACT_MATCH / MISMATCH / UNKNOWN per input, preparation/circuit, control, compiler, runtime/profile; no candidate-name-only join

model_validation_rules: mark old training observations and historical validation observations
the same candidate may compare multiple models without becoming independent new evidence
no zero fill or extrapolation across input series
compiler/profile variants are separate observation layers
never stop benchmark collection solely because the model misses a valid direct observation
